upstreamGaps.finding: the official Button animates its spinner with no prefers-reduced-motion handling
upstreamGaps.consumerRemedy: wrap or extend in the consuming project; recorded rather than patched locally

upstreamGaps.finding: with showTextWhileLoading=false the label is hidden during loading, so an isLoading button needs its own accessible name
upstreamGaps.consumerRemedy: pass aria-label (or showTextWhileLoading) on buttons used in loading state

postInstall: import the adopted stylesheet in the app entry so Tailwind sees the upstream theme
Tailwind v4 plugins declared in the stylesheet must be installed (listed under dependencies.tailwindPlugins)
upstream gap: REDUCED_MOTION — wrap or extend in the consuming project; recorded rather than patched locally
